 Teen Advisory Board at MCPL
 The Teen Advisory Board (TAB) is a group of library teen volunteers that helps the library and the community by implementing, promoting and advocating for youth services in Montgomery County.
 The Teen Advisory Board will provide feedback on programs, assist librarians with planning and running events and will be library advocates.
 How to Join
 Please complete the Teen Advisory Board Interest Form and someone will contact you after it's been received. All applicants must be 13 or in 8th grade at time of application up to 17 or 18 and a Senior in high school.
 SSL Hours
 You earn SSL hours for attending TAB meetings and there will be more opportunities to volunteer at Montgomery County Public Libraries in the coming year.
